prediction_text: Yes — Britain votes to leave the European Union. In the referendum of 23 June 2016 the Leave side wins narrowly, against the February polling lead for Stay, and the result is declared on 24 June 2016.
basis:
Card carries no tradition field; the card is a mundane-astrology referendum assessment, method chosen accordingly.
systems_used: western mundane astrology (Uranus transit to national charts). Card facts: on referendum day Uranus and Ceres conjunct at 23 degrees Aries — Uranus is the disruption/rupture planet and Aries is the sign of unilateral assertion; applied to the UK national charts (1066, 1801, 1922 all supplied on the card), the signature favours a break with the existing order over continuity. February polls showing Stay ahead with vast numbers of undecided voters are a weak contrary signal: undecided-heavy polling in a rupture configuration resolves toward change. R87 candidate coordinates: 23 June 2016 (referendum day, trigger = the Uranus-Ceres conjunction and the vote) taken; declaration 24 June as the settling point.
